en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a mid‑20th‑century town center with a tall modernist high‑rise bearing the logos "SKB" and "Tempo". At its base are shops and a bank; one sign reads "HANDELSBANKEN". To the right are parked 1950s–60s European cars and pedestrians. Several shopfront signs in a Germanic/Scandinavian script are visible, including a "POST" sign on a building and a pedestrian crossing sign in the foreground.
